claim.claim: Coca-Cola's net operating revenues for the quarter ended October 2, 2026 increased year over year.

verdict.label: SUPPORTED

supporting_evidence.quote: During the three months ended October 2, 2026, net operating revenues were $13,380 million, compared to $12,455 million during the three months ended September 26, 2025, an increase of $925 million, or 7%.
